title: Energy Release
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that alpha-decay energies are greater than zero, indicating a favorable energy release for alpha-decay compared to other decay modes.

title: Coulomb Barrier Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain that the probability of penetrating the Coulomb barrier is lower for fission compared to alpha-decay due to larger effective charges and reduced mass.

title: Comparison of Decay Modes
description: Important Criteria: The student must compare the decay energies of proton-, deuteron-, and triton-emission, stating that they are typically less than zero for heavy nuclei.

title: Mathematical Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include relevant equations or integrals that describe the Coulomb barrier penetration probability, enhancing their explanation.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid incorrect signs when discussing energy values, as negative decay energies for other modes must be clearly stated.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all energy values are presented with appropriate units (MeV) to avoid confusion.
